name: Mealie
description: What is on today’s meal plan in Mealie
comment: Mealie 2.0 and later; 1.x used /api/groups/mealplans/today. Checked against the source (routes/households/controller_mealplan.py, schema/meal_plan). The answer is a list at the top level, in camelCase; recipe is null for an entry that is only a note, which has a title instead. Today is the server's day, so Mealie needs the right TZ.

source.name: Meal plan
source.secretHint: In Mealie, under your profile, API Tokens: make a token for GDash.
